mapper.select: SELECT CONFIG_ID, PROFILE, PROP_KEY, PROP_VALUE, DATA_TYPE, EDITABLE_YN, RESTART_YN, DESCRIPTION, USE_YN FROM SYS_CONFIG WHERE PROFILE IN ('common', #{profile}) AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE PROFILE WHEN 'common' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, PROP_KEY
